picks.headline: Meta Glasses review: a bit less polish, a lot more baggage
picks.excerpt: Meta's new $299 branded AI glasses deliver the same Meta AI voice assistant and camera features as pricier Ray-Ban models, testing whether cheaper hardware can push AI eyewear mainstream.
picks.rationale: A real hands-on review of Meta's cheaper $299 AI glasses - the Meta-eyewear counterpoint to Samsung's Unpacked reveals, and a concrete read on whether lower-cost AI glasses are ready for daily use.

picks.headline: Samsung's slimmer Galaxy Z Flip 8 brings apps and AI to the cover screen
picks.excerpt: The Galaxy Z Flip 8 pushes Galaxy AI and full apps onto its expanded cover display, letting Gemini-powered features run without opening the phone.
picks.rationale: The foldables/Galaxy AI pick - a distinct cover-screen UX story (full apps + Gemini without opening the phone), not the already-published Gemini Nano 4 on-device model announcement.

picks.headline: An unholy union of smart glasses and wireless earbuds is upon us
picks.excerpt: A new category of camera-equipped wireless earbuds with onboard AI is emerging, letting wearers ask an AI model about what's in front of them without pulling out a phone - earbuds edging into smart-glasses territory.
picks.rationale: The camera-earbuds angle - a genuinely new device category (AI camera earbuds) distinct from every Samsung/Meta glasses story, signaling where hands-free ambient AI wearables are heading.
